name: RAGTruth
description: RAGTruth is a corpus designed to analyze word-level hallucinations in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks for large language models. It contains nearly 18,000 manually annotated responses from diverse LLMs, enabling evaluation of hallucination intensity and detection methods.
reputation: RAGTruth is a recent, widely cited benchmark for word-level hallucination analysis in retrieval-augmented generation, especially for evaluating hallucination detection methods.
notes: Focuses on word-level hallucination annotation and detection in RAG frameworks; includes manual annotations and evaluation of hallucination detection methods.
